source_binding: The exact final commit and package SHA256 are recorded in package-manifest.json and the companion package validation receipt; this file does not embed its own package hash.

backend.note: Final full backend after the rereview fixes and gap tests, with no synthetic service or local worker competing for PostgreSQL.

browser.screenshots: 16 synthetic screens captured at 1440 and 390 widths (32 PNG files plus metadata); retained in private evidence
browser.note: Final phase-2 Port Console UI run on a fresh synthetic schema; OTP rate limits and the 3-second database connection timeout were not changed.

ui_replan.direction: Port Console (Impeccable Operate mode), polished with unslop Manifest Desk
ui_replan.phases: phase 1 shell + phase 2 record command bar, billing source structure, form rhythm; unslop neutral ramp, 4px rhythm, weights <=500, 8/12px radii and one 16px icon system; public welcome manifest desk and internal queue board
ui_replan.unslop_credit: unslop by Damir Sokolovsky (@heydamir), CC BY 4.0, github.com/heydamir/unslop
ui_replan.unchanged: business fields, labels, field order, state meanings, permissions, APIs and external acceptance boundaries

rereview.new_findings: NEW-I01 CLOSED; NEW-M01 CLOSED after member-warehouse write checks; NEW-M03/M04/M05 adopted; NEW-M02/M06/M07 recorded as accepted minor boundaries
rereview.new_breakage: none reported after the fix confirmations

rereview_gap_tests: old ungrouped ticket edited to the same identity regroups (FR-I05)
active manufacturer hold blocks release order (FR-I03)
document recovery cannot exceed the shared native source (FR-I04)
replacement cannot exceed the shared native source (FR-I04)
clearing AP preview is idempotent and a stale preview is rejected (FR-I09)
recovered group invoices accept a fresh explicit allocation; recovery never auto-allocates (FR-I01)
customer copy is denied after ownership changes (FR-I08)

native_group_scale.scope: Owned synthetic 125k benchmark extension; no production data
native_group_scale.note: Warm local synthetic measurement; not a production SLA. Larger memberships, concurrency and cold caches remain unverified.

migration.pre_upgrade_isolated_restore: verified in a separate owned database
migration.post_upgrade_backup: created and verified by isolated restore (runtime fence frozen)
migration.readonly_smoke: welcome 200, public profile 200, unauthenticated session 401, 209 API paths
